answer: Heartbeat bond: each identity locks 70 credits, holds a timber tally sealed with a copper token. Randomly the beacon sends a whisper summons; the named identity must return its checksum in an hour or lose the bond. Each summons costs 24; the k-th fake costs 24+6(k-1), each fake needing its own machine, so 100 fakes pay 32,100 plus 7,000 locked. Rented tallies sharing a trail are flagged. An honest identity answers once, pays 24, keeps its bond.
